3603-4364-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3603-4364-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Move to your next turn. Optionally, you can instead give Massimo haste.
Declare Massimo and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 4 each combat phase.
3603-4364-8330.notes: You can also do this combo in one turn if you give the ability to a creature that has haste (excluding Aurelia) instead. If you give the ability to another creature, you will need to cause that creature to enter, target the creature with Massimo, and then replace Massimo in the combat phase with the creature. If you do this in one turn, either with Massimo or another creature, ensure that Aurelia has not attacked during that turn.

4060-4881-6909-7884.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4060-4881-6909-7884.description:
Cast Volatile Claws by paying {2}{R}, causing creatures you control to get +2/+0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

4050-6747-8077-8107.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
4050-6747-8077-8107.description:
Cast Raffine's Guidance from your graveyard by paying {W} due to Sami.
Sigil of the Empty Throne triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Raffine's Guidance, attaching it to another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Raffine's Guidance attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

640-1981-2034-2415.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2292-2415-4446.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1170-5060-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5060-5131-5226--202.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1170-5060-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2073-2829-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-2829-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1115-2034-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1742-5742-5743-7824.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Skirge Familiar ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2043-4460-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-4460-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

215-5457-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-5457-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-5457-7297.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

997-1619-4605-5542-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2146-3532-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2146-3532-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

360-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1402-2218-4763-5434.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1441-4231-7070.description:
Cast Bill either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Bill enters, its first ability triggers, creating two Food, Clue and Treasure tokens due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Bill by sacrificing a Food, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Bill.
Bill's ability from step 3 fizzles due to having no legal targets.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Cast Bill from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

1052-2292-3175.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

775-1409-2557.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1170-3110-3363-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3200-3562.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sky Hussar.
When Sky Hussar enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

465-2921-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3617-4423-6701-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
3617-4423-6701-6886.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

372-2974-3563.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Flicker of Fate.
372-2974-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

1012-2034-5220--53.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
1012-2034-5220--53.notes: If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, the combo nets infinite colorless mana.

1987-2404-2468-2751.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
1987-2404-2468-2751.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Gaea's Cradle and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-1469-2459-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress.
Repeat.

575-2482-3470-5624.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Nervous Gardener enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

624-3719-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
624-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Phantasmal Image has a power of at least 2.
624-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Phantasmal Image and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Phantasmal Image to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Phantasmal Image by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-4050-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fiendish Panda, adding one mana of any color.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Pinnacle Monk

957-2665-5913.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk.
When the token Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

856-1575-3967-5903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
856-1575-3967-5903.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

235-1811-3231.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand that can target a single creature and deal damage to it.
You have enough mana to pay for the instant or sorcery.
235-1811-3231.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, targeting Zada.
Zada triggers, copying the spell for each other creature you control the spell could target, ensuring that Imodane's copy is put onto the stack first.
Resolve the first copy, dealing twice the listed amount of damage to the targeted creature.
Imodane triggers, dealing four times the listed amount of damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining copy.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-1170-4036-5293.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library and/or graveyard for Rite of Flame and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Rite of Flame by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Seething Song from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Rite of Flame, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2274-4191-4229.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Islands.
2274-4191-4229.description:
Cast Selkie Hedge-Mage by paying {0}.
Selkie Hedge-Mage enters the battlefield tapped due to Orb of Dreams, triggering its second ability, as well as its first ability if you control at least two Forests.
If applicable, resolve the first Selkie Hedge-Mage trigger, causing you to gain three life.
Resolve the second Selkie Hedge-Mage trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1506-3238-3500.notablePrerequisites:
Phyrexian Colossus does not have summoning sickness.
Basilisk Collar and Burning Anger attached to Phyrexian Colossus.
1506-3238-3500.description:
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by tapping it, dealing 8 damage to any target and causing you to gain eight life.
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by paying eight life, untapping it.
Repeat.

702-1173-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
702-1173-3976.description:
Cast Final Fortune by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Final Fortune and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Stunning Reversal and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Move to your next turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with both face down creatures, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to cast a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to cast a copy of Stunning Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Stunning Reversal.
At the beginning of your end step, Final Fortune triggers, causing your life total to become one and you to draw seven cards due to Stunning Reversal.
Repeat from step 4.

396-1218-5064.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Goblins.
396-1218-5064.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Skirk Fire Marshal +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five untapped Goblins, giving each opposing creature ten -1/-1 counters and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten poison counters.

2232-2757-3474-4000.notablePrerequisites: Rhys in hand.You control a basic Forest.
2232-2757-3474-4000.description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Rhys by paying {G}.
Rhys enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Rhys, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rhys from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Cat Warrior token, untapping a basic Forest.
Repeat.

721-1598-2724.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Sunken Hope triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Repeat each turn.

1108-4944.description:
Activate Chimeric Idol by paying {0}, tapping all lands you control, causing Chimeric Idol to become a 3/3 Turtle artifact creature until end of turn.
Crackdown Construct triggers, gaining +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
